comparison.objective: Close a gas-cylinder valve and install a lockout cap; candidate adjusts an isolated axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve rotation and cap fitting versus hex-key insertion, body counterhold, collar adjustment and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Valve closed and cap locked versus two non-bottoming carriage cycles with retained setting.
comparison.reason: Both involve safety isolation and rotation, but the lockout task tests securing a valve, not iterative dynamic commissioning. Detailed lock engagement criteria are missing.
